idea-plugin.name: NYX Dev Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Dark glass themes for JetBrains IDEs, inspired by Nyx, the Greek goddess of night.

Layered warm near-black surfaces, a single lilac accent and an editor color scheme tuned to match each UI theme.

Included themes

  • NYX — lilac keywords, lavender functions, peach strings and amber numbers.
  • NYX Blackout — the NYX palette on pure black.
  • NYX Graphite — near monochrome code with lilac keywords and a soft caret row.
  • NYX Eclipse — lilac keywords, blue functions, mint strings and amber numbers.

How to use

Go to Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance and pick a NYX theme. The matching editor scheme is applied automatically; if not, select it under Editor → Color Scheme.

Free and open. If NYX makes your nights better, you can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.
